UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Stores core progress data, XP, streak achievements, and list of scenario progress.

xp.description: The lifetime cumulative experience points earned by the user.

streak.description: The consecutive number of days the user has been active.

lastActiveDate.description: The last calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) when the user earned XP.

completedScenarios.description: List of finished scenario IDs. Strictly capped by the 100 library count.

inProgressScenarios.description: List of currently active/in-progress scenario IDs.

dailyGoalXp.description: Target XP for a single day.

dailyXpGained.description: XP gained in the current day.

isPremium.description: True if user has an active premium subscription, unlocking advanced scenarios, Leitner boxes, and coach chatter.

SrsFlashcard.title: SrsFlashcard
SrsFlashcard.description: An individual physical leitner box vocabulary spaced repetition card.

PracticeDay.title: PracticeDay
PracticeDay.description: A specific date on which the user engaged with the application.

xpGained.description: Points earned during this specific practice date.

timestamp.description: The exact full timestamp of creation metadata.

/users/{userId}.description: Root user profiles representing user gamified details.

/users/{userId}/flashcards/{flashcardId}.description: Sub-collection preserving Leitner box items for the specific user.

/users/{userId}/practice_days/{dateStrin.description: Sub-collection logging actual historical dates of practice.
